title: Air at the lip: /f/ and /v/
goal: Practise /f/ and /v/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Let your upper teeth touch your lower lip lightly. Let air flow for f; add voice for v. Do not bite your lip.
spelling: f usually represents /f/. The v in van represents /v/. Keep both sounds distinct from b.
task: Request five of an item. Repeat the number clearly if asked.
story: A fan is in the van. The van has five seats.
reviewPrompt: Return to day 7, 14, 18, 20. Recall a word or say one useful phrase before opening those lessons.

articulation.label: fan
articulation.alt: fan: /f/ → /æ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
